simple.meaning: קָצַר (qâtsar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to dock off , i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 51 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, Ruth, and 13 more, beginning at Leviticus 19:9. Its contexts include priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָצַר (H7114).
